subject.title: fix: keep inbound metadata in runtime context

question: Should maintainers refresh and land this focused before-user runtime-context handoff, or use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100272 as the canonical tail-carrier implementation?
rationale: Both branches preserve inbound metadata outside user-authored prompt text, but they differ on carrier placement and prompt-cache behavior; automation cannot choose that compatibility and cache-contract tradeoff safely.

options.title: Use tail-carrier path
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100272 as canonical if maintainers accept its broader provider/cache changes, then preserve this PR’s focused tests or credit before retiring the branch.

options.title: Refresh focused branch
options.body: Rebase this PR onto current main, preserve PR 95349 and PR 92593 behavior, and merge the narrower fix while accepting the residual cache-placement limitation.

options.title: Keep paused briefly
options.body: Leave both PRs open until the prompt-layout decision is made, avoiding a premature close while the central bug remains unfixed on main.

recommendation.title: Use tail-carrier path
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100272 as canonical if maintainers accept its broader provider/cache changes, then preserve this PR’s focused tests or credit before retiring the branch.
